title: Icicle rollout timetable and fallout cues — Nov 2027 (wip)
content:
Purpose: compact, day-by-day runbook and quick-fallout cues for ‘Icicle’ feature roll (model-routing + routing-policies). Designed for a small-window, multi-region stagger with lanes for low-latency customers and an emergency rollback lane.

Context and constraints:
- Codename: Icicle (feature flag: feat/icicle-routing).
- Scope: routing policy changes, small config schema migration, runtime kernel selector tweak on GPU pools. No DB schema changes.
- Risk profile: medium (behavioural: routing variance, perf regressions at tail).
- Primary metric guardrails: p50/p95 latency, token throughput, error-rate, model-fallback ratio, customer error SLO.
- Watch channels: #release-ops (primary), #sre-oncall (escalation), #prod-telemetry.

Quick preflight (to be done by owners listed):
- [ ] Merge gate: all PRs merged to release branch and CI green (owner: Marco Li).
- [ ] Canary images built and uploaded to registry (owner: Riley). Verify digest.
- [ ] Smoke harness scripted — smoke-suite/icicle-smoke hitting staging with 99% pass (owner: Sofia).
- [ ] Telemetry hooks: ensure telemetry tags present (route=icicle, rollout_phase) (owner: Benji).
- [ ] Feature flag created with target audiences and default off (owner: Aisha).
- [ ] KMS rotation window avoided during rollout (ops note).

Staggered rollout timetable (week view):
- D-7 (Mon): Final acceptance tests on staging. Dry-run of traffic shaping (10k reqs, mixed seq lengths). Run perf script: perf/icicle-stress.
- D-5 (Wed): Pre-rollout sync: oncall table, pager paths, gameplan readout 14:00 PT. Canary cluster reserved.
- D-3 (Fri): Canary #1: 0.5% internal traffic (non-paying test accounts). Observe 4h window. Check latency tail and fallback counts.
- D-2 (Sat): Canary #2: 2% mixed traffic (EU region). Run smoke for 8h, confirm no increase in 5xx and p99 < baseline+40ms.
- D (Sun - launch window 02:00–06:00 UTC): Regional ramping lanes. See day-of ops timeline.
- D+1 (Mon): Expand to 10% regionally, kick off dataset of canary prompts for quality regressions.
- D+3 (Wed): 30% overall; evaluate cost signals and batching KPIs.
- D+7 (Tue): 60% with decays (observe any customer-facing bugs).
- D+14: Full rollout or rollback decision.

Day-of ops timeline (02:00–06:00 UTC window):
- 01:30: Final go/no-go call on #release-ops. Escalation path confirmed.
- 01:45: Snapshot telemetry (baseline p50/p95/p99, error-rate, token/sec). Tag snapshot id: icicle-pre-<timestamp>.
- 02:00: Enable flag for lane A (internal + low-risk) -> 1% traffic.
- 02:15: Verify logs for anomalies (sudden 5xx, KV cache misses). Run quick comparison: pre vs current cache-hit%.
- 02:45: If stable, enable lane B -> add 4% (total 5%).
- 03:30: Run synthetic QA prompts and a short A/B regressions script against golden-set (prompt-regress/icicle/golden-v1).
- 04:30: If metrics within guardrails, open regional expansion: EU -> US -> APAC in 30-min increments.
- 05:45: Finalize 06:00 snapshot and prepare rollforward notes.

Immediate fallout cues and triage ladder (fast checks):
1) Latency spike: check recent kernel selection logs and queueing (owner: Marco). If p99 > baseline + 100ms for > 5m, throttle new lanes and rollback to previous kernel-selector config.
2) Fallback surge (rapid increase in model-fallback ratio): check model-loading errors and KV cache warmup. If > 3x baseline for 10m, trigger partial rollback (remove lane B) and force fallback to safe-model.
3) Error-rate climb (5xx spike): check infra (node OOM, GPU driver) and request logs. If scoped to a single region, isolate region and pause rollout there.
4) Quality regressions (semantic failure): revert feature-flag globally and kick off rollback. Preserve logs for evaluation.

Rollback decision checklist (must be unanimous among on-call, release lead, product owner for immediate rollbacks):
- [ ] Evidence collected: telemetry snapshot + sample request traces.
- [ ] Rollback action documented in channel and incident ticket created (JIRA key attached).
- [ ] Communication plan executed (customer-impacting: customer-success notified).
- [ ] Post-rollback monitoring plan in place for 24h.

Post-release short notes (to capture while warm):
- Immediate telemetry to capture: route/icicle: token/sec, cache-hit%, p50/p95/p99 latency, fallback_ratio, 5xx_rate.
- Quality harness: run full golden-set diff (annotate failures with request-id).
- Cost sampling: compare per-token cost delta for production traffic slice.

Release notes draft (for product and CS review):
Title: Icicle: smarter routing policy update (gradual rollout)
Summary: Introduces route-based model routing and improved kernel selection heuristics to reduce token costs under common sequences while maintaining latency targets. Rolling out gradually to minimize risk.
Included changes:
- New routing policy config that allows route affinity and token-length-aware model selection.
- Kernel selector heuristics tuned for long-context sequences (reduces p50 on bursty workloads).
- Telemetry tags added: rollout_phase, route=icicle.
Known issues / caveats:
- In early canaries we observed elevated fallback ratios for synthetic long prompts until cache warmup completes (~10–15 min).
- Some SRE dashboards need the new telemetry tags added (listed in linked_artifacts).
Migration steps for customers (if opt-in):
- Customers using custom routing rules should test in a sandbox with feat/icicle-routing turned on. Contact solutions-eng for per-customer tune.

Outstanding questions / TODOs (notes to self):
- [ ] Add alert thresholds to SLO repo for new tags (owner: Benji).
- [ ] Get CS note approved by product (owner: Sofia) before D+1.
- [ ] Post-release retro slot: D+10 16:00 PT. Add owners and invite list.

Appendix: quick commands and pointers
- Deploy image check: curl -s registry.redwood/serving/icicle:latest | jq .digest
- Run perf harness: ./scripts/perf/icicle-stress --qps 500 --duration 20m
- Telemetry snapshot: telemetryctl snapshot --tags route=icicle --out icicle-snap-<ts>.json
- Incident template: JIRA-REL-4128 (use template: release-fallout-minor)

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally compact — please flag any missing telem points or guardrail thresholds you'd like tightened. Keep language tight for the CS release note; the draft above is intentionally minimal and technical.

-- Aisha (release lead)
